about_the_game:
Trauma Football is sweeping the nation!

A football game unlike anything you've ever seen before! Experience the thrill of dealing with a mentally unstable boss, nagging journalists and social climbers, all the while having to keep up with top players from all around the world!

Trauma Football features:

-A gameplay loop unlike anything you've ever seen in a football game (or any sports game, for that matter!) lovingly crafted to keep both newcomers and experts engaged from beginning to end!

-An extensive editor that allows you to modify not just the appearance, but also the skills, the positioning and behaviour of your team!

-A narratively intruguing Season mode with an unmatched variety of challenges and scenarios to test your skills with!

-Multiple ways to customize every single game! Put your team of 5 against a team of 8 and vice-versa! Set up penalties if your opponent does certain actions, change the weather, the goal size, the time limit, the world is your oyster!

-Illegal sports betting.

-A slew of unlockable secrets and unique features to keep the player always wanting for more!

Trauma Football! Out september 11th!

content_descriptors.notes: Decent amount of swearing and risqué humor all around. Nothing too controversial or anything.
